description: This Java class 'FeignLoanHelper' provides helper methods for interacting with the Fineract loan services via Feign client. It includes methods to create loan products, apply for loans, approve loans, disburse loans, fetch loan details, undo actions, and perform combined apply and approve operations.

classes.name: FeignLoanHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing loan-related operations via the Fineract Feign client, including creation, application, approval, disbursement, and retrieval of loans.

methods.name: createLoanProduct
methods.description: Creates a new loan product using the provided request data.

methods.name: applyForLoan
methods.description: Submits a loan application with the specified details.

methods.name: approveLoan
methods.description: Transitions the loan to an approved state.

methods.name: getLoanDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific loan.

methods.name: applyAndApproveLoan
methods.description: Convenience method to apply for a new loan and automatically approve it.
